title: LensBet
tagline: Lensbet is a decentralized betting game, utilizing a decentralized oracle to enabling the gaming to be fairly conducted in social network
description:
Welcome to the BettingGame project! This innovative project integrates with Reality.eth decentralized Oracle to create a betting game on Ethereum.

BettingGame utilizes Reality.eth to offer a decentralized betting experience:

Bet Creation 🛠️: Users create bets based on Reality.eth questions, staking ETH or ERC20 tokens.
Joining Bets 🤝: Participants join by staking on potential outcomes.
Outcome Resolution 🏆: The contract settles bets according to the resolved Reality.eth question, distributing stakes to winners proportionally.
how_its_made:
Arbitration and Asset-Heavy Influence 💼
The arbitration process can be skewed by asset-heavy individuals who influence outcomes through substantial bonds. This can compromise fairness.

Quadratic Voting During Arbitration 🗳️
We address this with Quadratic Voting:

Voting Power 🔋: Voting power increases quadratically with assets, reducing the influence of wealth.
Fair Representation 🎭: This ensures democratic outcomes, limiting the dominance of wealthy individuals.
Implementation 🛠️: In Reality.eth, this could involve adjusting bonds based on participant diversity.
Frontend Integration: Lens Smart Post 🖥️
Our project's frontend is innovatively integrated as a Lens Smart Post. Lens Protocol, known for its decentralized social media framework, allows us to leverage blockchain technology for a transparent, interactive user interface. This integration ensures:

Decentralized Interaction 🌍: Users interact with the BettingGame in a decentralized environment.
Enhanced User Experience ✨: The Lens Smart Post provides a user-friendly interface for bet creation, participation, and tracking.
Community Engagement 💬: Leveraging social media aspects, users can discuss, share, and promote bets within the Lens ecosystem.
